WigglerMainRt.name: Wiggler main routine
summary: Wiggler (sprite 86). Each Wiggler keeps a history of its last 63 (X,Y) positions in a buffer in bank $7F; the five segments are drawn from
points along that history, which makes the body follow the head. Behaviour: walks left/right, turns at walls, and when stomped by Mario
flashes for $40 frames, becomes angry (faster, red) and releases a flower. Interaction and drawing are in WigglerTiles below.
Parameters: X = sprite index. Uses [$D5]-[$D7] as a pointer to the position buffer.

s02F103.name: Data: Wiggler segment history offsets and bob
summary: $02F103: byte offsets into the position history for the 5 segments (normal). $02F108: vertical bob per animation phase.

WigglerTiles.name: Wiggler draw, contact and flower spawn
summary: $02F10C: body tile animation table (4 frames). $02F110: draws the head, four body segments and the eyes or flower (6 OAM tiles), then
tests Mario against each segment: star kills it, a stomp bounces Mario and makes it angry, otherwise Mario is hurt.
$02F2D7 (end of this section) spawns the flower extended sprite when it turns angry.
Parameters: X = sprite index; [$D5] = position buffer pointer.

s02F2D3.name: Data: Wiggler flower and eye X offsets
summary: $02F2D3: X offset of the flower on the head by direction (0, 8). The next two bytes are the eye X offsets.

WigglerEyesX.name: Wiggler eye offsets, flower spawn
summary: $02F2D5: X offset of the angry eyes by direction (4, 4). $02F2D7: finds a free extended sprite slot and spawns the Wiggler flower
(extended sprite $0E) at the Wiggler's position, thrown upward with X speed opposite to the Wiggler's.

BirdsMain.name: Yoshi's House bird main
summary: Sprite 8A. Wrapper: sets the data bank, runs the bird logic and returns long. A bird hops around on the ground and pecks.
State [RAM_SpriteState]: 0 = hopping, 1 = standing and pecking. Frame in [$1602] selects the tile; $15AC = turn-around timer.

BirdsPtrs.name: Pointer table: bird states
summary: State 0: hopping ($02F342), state 1: pecking ($02F38F).

s02F33C.name: Data: bird hop counts and X speeds
summary: $02F33C: number of hops/pecks, picked at random (2,3,5,1). $02F340: X speed by direction (+8, -8).

s02F342.name: Bird state logic
summary: $02F342: hopping state. Walks at +/-8, and each time it lands (Y >= $E8) it snaps to the ground and jumps again (Y speed $F0).
Near the left/right area edge it turns around; after the hop count runs out it switches to the pecking state.
$02F38F: pecking state. Stops, shows frame 1 for the last 8 frames of a random timer, then goes back to hopping, sometimes
turning around ($02F3C1) and choosing a new hop count.

BirdsTilemap.name: Table: bird tiles
summary: Tile by frame [$1602]: $D2, $D3 = hop frames, $D0, $D1 = peck frames, $9B = turning.

BirdsFlip.name: Table: bird flip bits
summary: OAM property flip bits by direction: $71 = flipped (facing right), $31 = normal.

BirdsPal.name: Table: bird palettes
summary: OAM palette bits by (sprite index AND 3), so neighbouring birds have different colours.

FireplaceTilemap.name: Table: bird OAM slots, bird draw
summary: $02F3E6: OAM offsets (in the $0200 low table) used by the four birds, indexed by sprite index AND 3.
$02F3EA: draws one bird as a single 8x8 sprite at its screen position in that fixed OAM slot, using the tile for frame [$1602].

SmokeMain.name: Yoshi's House chimney smoke main
summary: Sprite 8B. Wrapper. The puff drifts up at 1/4 pixel per frame, sways left/right every $40 frames, is drawn as two mirrored puffs
and is removed when it reaches the top of the screen. [$1540] delays the sideways motion after spawning.

s02F463.name: Table: smoke puff spread
summary: Half-distance between the two smoke puffs, by age in [$151C] (increments every 16 frames); grows from 3 to 8.

s02F47C.name: Draw smoke puffs
summary: Draws two 16x16 puffs (tile $C5) spread apart horizontally by the table value, the second one X-flipped, with palette 2.
Parameters: X = sprite index.

SideExitMain.name: Yoshi's House fireplace main
summary: Sprite 8C. Wrapper. Sets the side exit flag [$1B96], then (only if the sprite's X position bit 4 is clear) draws the fireplace
flame and lets it spawn smoke.

s02F4E7.name: Data: fireplace flame tiles
summary: $02F4E7: top tile for the two flicker frames ($D4, $AB). $02F4E9: bottom tile ($BB, $9A).

s02F4EB.name: Fireplace draw, smoke spawn, castle wrappers
summary: $02F4EB: draws the flame as two 8x8 tiles at a fixed screen position ($B8, $B0/$B8), occasionally flipping to the other frame.
$02F53E: every 64 frames calls $02F548, which spawns a smoke sprite (8B) at the chimney with a $20 frame delay.
$02F57C, $02F584, $02F58C: long wrappers (data bank = $02) for three castle entrance animation routines called from bank $00;
the last one ($02F58C) is unreferenced in practice.

GhostExitMain.name: Ghost House exit main
summary: Sprite 8D wrapper: saves X, sets the data bank, calls the exit drawing routine at $02F5D0 and returns long.

s02F59E.name: Data: exit tile X positions
summary: Low 8 bits of X for the ten exit tiles (relative to the level's left edge).

s02F5A8.name: Data: exit tile X high bytes
summary: X high byte per tile ($FF = left of the screen edge).

s02F5B2.name: Data: exit tile Y positions
summary: Screen Y of each tile.

s02F5BC.name: Data: exit tile numbers
summary: Tile number of each sprite.

s02F5C6.name: Data: exit tile properties
summary: OAM property (flip, palette, priority) of each tile.

s02F5D0.name: Draw Ghost House exit
summary: Draws ten 16x16 tiles at fixed screen positions, only while the screen scroll X is below $46 (start of the level).
Parameters: X = ten tile loop index; Y = $A0 start OAM offset.

s02F619.name: Data: castle entrance sprite table
summary: Four 8-entry tables used by the unused routine at $02F639: X offsets, Y offsets, tiles, properties.
